Name: EQUIP_PARAM_ACCESSORY_ST
Description: Defines talismans. A talisman's passive effects are its SpEffects: Reference ID (when Reference Type is SpEffect) and Passive SpEffect ID 1-4, all applied while it is equipped. Talismans that share an Accessory Group can't be worn together.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Development flag for network-test builds. Not read by the retail game.
Reserved. Appears unused by the game.
Reserved. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Reference ID
Fields.Description: First passive SpEffect of the talisman, applied while it is equipped. Only used when Reference Type is 2 (SpEffect); with any other type this field gives nothing. Retail: every talisman uses type 2.

Fields.Name: SFX Variation ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always -1.

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Weight. Added to the equip load with the other worn equipment.

Fields.Name: Behavior ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Basic Price
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Sell Value
Fields.Description: Runes received when selling the talisman.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Inventory sort order.

Fields.Name: QWC ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Equip Model ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: talismans have no model. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon ID.

Fields.Name: Shop Level
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Achievement Grade ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Achievement Sequential ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Equip Model Category
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: talismans have no model. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Equip Model Gender
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: talismans have no model. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Accessory Category
Fields.Description: Equipment category. Only 0 (Talisman) is mapped to the talisman equip slots when the game works out where the item can be equipped. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Reference Type
Fields.Description: What Reference ID points to. Only 2 (SpEffect) is used: Reference ID is then applied as a passive SpEffect. Retail: always 2.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Category
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Sort Group ID
Fields.Description: Sort group: items with the same group are listed together when sorting by item type. 255: none.

Fields.Name: Vagrant Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always -1.

Fields.Name: Vagrant Bonus Enemy Drop Lot ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always -1.

Fields.Name: Vagrant Enemy Drop Lot ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always -1.

Fields.Name: Can Store in Chest
Fields.Description: The item can be put in the storage chest.

Fields.Name: Is Destroyed on Unequip
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: always off.

Fields.Name: Cannot Drop for Others
Fields.Description: A dropped copy can't be shared with other players in multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Can Discard
Fields.Description: The item can be discarded from the inventory.

Fields.Name: Can Drop
Fields.Description: The item can be dropped on the ground. Retail: off only on the Entwining Umbilical Cord and one unnamed row.

Fields.Name: Show in Acquisition Log
Fields.Description: The item appears in the item acquisition log when obtained. Retail: always on.

Fields.Name: Acquisition Dialog Condition
Fields.Description: Controls the pop-up shown when the item is obtained. Retail: always 2.

Fields.Name: Rarity
Fields.Description: Item rarity, shown in menus and in the pop-up when the item is obtained.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Shop Price
Fields.Description: Default shop price: a shop lineup row whose own price is negative uses this value instead (still scaled and offset by that row's price multiplier and addition). -1 also makes one shop menu check reject the item. Retail: always 0.

Fields.Name: Accessory Group
Fields.Description: Talismans with the same group can't be equipped together: the equip menu marks those that share a group with one already worn. -1: no group. Retail: the tiers of a talisman share one group (for example every Crimson Amber Medallion is 1000).

Fields.Name: Cannot Be Obtained
Fields.Description: The item can't be obtained, and copies already held are removed by the inventory check. Retail: always 0.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Completion Achievement ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 17 on the 8 legendary talismans (matching the Legendary Talismans achievement), -1 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID [1]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied while the talisman is equipped, alongside Reference ID and the other passive SpEffects. Retail uses 0 for none.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID [2]
Fields.Description: Second additional SpEffect applied while the talisman is equipped. Retail uses 0 for none.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID [3]
Fields.Description: Third additional SpEffect applied while the talisman is equipped. Retail uses 0 for none.

Fields.Name: Passive SpEffect ID [4]
Fields.Description: Fourth additional SpEffect applied while the talisman is equipped. Retail uses 0 for none.
Padding.
